  PROBLEM: The overlap jq `def names` (lines 1458-1467) and `_merge_lease_pr_paths` (lines 2578-2579) merge `.filename` and `.previous_filename` into one list, so a shared path is classed soft or hard by its name alone; when a soft path is renamed to a hard path on either the PR side or the base side, only the soft name is shared, `_pr_merge_tree_probe` runs, and merge-ort follows the rename and reports a clean merge.
  WHY: `_pr_base_freshness` returns `clean reason=soft_paths_merge_clean` and the PR merges with no update-branch and no CI run, so the merged content of a hard file is never tested. The same input used to give `overlap reason=shared_paths`, and this breaks the linked issue's rule "never let it make a PR skip re-validation when it shares a non-soft path". `_merge_lease_paths_intersect` has the same gap. All five reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1458-1504, 2219-2220 | severity=high | confidence=5

  WHY: The real path is hard but gets `clean reason=soft_paths_merge_clean`, which skips the update-branch and re-validation. Severity disagrees: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT because the trigger is narrow, while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR. The highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2174-2182 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_soft_entries` parses `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS` by splitting on commas (`IFS=','`).
  WHY: A filename that contains a comma (e.g. `README.md,agents.d/x`) is split into several invalid entries, so a non-soft path can be classed as soft. Rated MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:217-219 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The sweep's base-sync path treats `clean` and `overlap` the same (`clean|overlap) ;;`), yet a soft-only overlap still makes `_pr_base_freshness` run `_pr_merge_tree_probe`. With no checkout, each probe creates a private bare repository and runs a depth-200 fetch (120 s timeout) per candidate PR per tick, up to `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`.
  WHY: Nothing breaks, but runner time and network fetches are spent on a result the sweep throws away. The suggested fix is `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS=none` on that call or step. The env line is cited as .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml line 948 by most reviewers and as :937 by openai_gpt-6-luna. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).

Phase 4 test bullet: "Every existing `tests/test_review_merge_train.py` probe test passes through the `_mt_*` wrappers."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_git`, `_mt_git_fetch`, `_mt_probe_repo_init`, `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup`, `_mt_conflict_probe` (cited as lines 658-809 / 660-809 / ~685-820), plus a wrapper-path test in tests/test_review_merge_train.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk touches scripts/review_merge_train.sh (it is absent from pr_changed_files.txt), and the file still holds its own full copy of the probe (`merge-train-probe.*` prefix, `_MT_PROBE_*` globals, the `MERGE_TRAIN_IGNORE_PATHS` mapping, `_mt_conflict_probe` called at line 482). scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh adds a separate `_pr_*` copy (from about line 2028, lines 2028-2278). `trap _mt_probe_repo_cleanup EXIT` at review_merge_train.sh:743 replaces the caller's trap instead of chaining onto it and drops `_pr_probe_repo_cleanup`. One process can end up with two private repos, two fetches of the same SHAs and two log prefixes that can drift apart (`MERGE_TRAIN_PROBE_REPO` vs `PR_MERGE_TREE_PROBE_REPO`). No test in tests/test_review_merge_train.py exercises the wrapper path. agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md:5 says the conversion "is pending". The files_touched grant leaves out review_merge_train.sh. === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_base_freshness, overlap jq lines 1458-1467, soft branch lines 1497-1520; _merge_lease_paths_intersect lines 2603-2611, _merge_lease_pr_paths lines 2578-2579 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A shared path is classed soft or hard by its name alone. The code never checks whether the path is one end of a rename whose other end is a hard path, on either the PR side or the base side, and merge-ort follows the rename and exits 0.
  WHY: The gate returns `clean reason=soft_paths_merge_clean`, `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` logs `action=proceed`, and the PR merges with no update-branch and no CI, so the merged content of a non-soft file is never tested. This breaks "never let it make a PR skip re-validation when it shares a non-soft path". In merge mode the PR can also merge past a lease holder. Fix: fail closed on renames by moving any shared path from a record with `previous_filename` into _MERGE_LEASE_HARD_LIST.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:line 1466 (`... | unique | join(",")`) and line 1499 (`_merge_lease_split_soft "$(printf '%s' "${overlap}" | tr ',' '\n')"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comma join and re-split lets a shared path whose name contains a comma, with every piece a soft entry, be classed as soft.
  WHY: It returns `clean reason=soft_paths_merge_clean` for a hard path. The trigger is narrow, because the first piece must be an exact soft entry. Fix: use a newline-separated list for the split, or treat any path containing "," as hard.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:line 217 `_pr_base_freshness "${number}" "${sha}" "" >/dev/null`, lines 218-219 `clean|overlap) ;;`, env at .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml line 948 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A soft-only overlap still runs `_pr_merge_tree_probe` (a private bare repo plus a depth-200 fetch with a 120 s timeout) for every candidate on every tick, and the result is thrown away.
  WHY: Nothing breaks, but runner time and fetches are wasted. Fix: prefix the call with `MERGE_LEASE_SOFT_PATHS=none`.

  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_git, _mt_git_fetch, _mt_probe_repo_init, _mt_probe_repo_cleanup, _mt_conflict_probe (plan reference: lines 658-809)
  Evidence of absence: The file is not in pr_changed_files.txt. Line 743 `trap _mt_probe_repo_cleanup EXIT` replaces the trap instead of chaining onto it and leaves a pr-merge-tree-probe.* directory behind under RUNNER_TEMP. pr_checks_lib.sh adds an independent copy from about line 2028, and the agents.d fragment says the work "is pending". With the final-CI resume pass at review_merge_train.sh:1979, one process gets two repos, two fetches and two log prefixes. The file is outside the files_touched grant, so a follow-up sub-issue is recommended.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
